lead_raw_text:
The structure of U6Si2B2 (reduced formula U3SiB) adopts the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies boron centers with nine neighbors (4 B, 2 Si, 3 U) and silicon centers with five U neighbors, while uranium environments range from 14 to 15 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between 9-vertex boron and 5-vertex silicon polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between boron and uranium polyhedra.
